opening.argument: The video presents a direct route into a Bitcoin-mining pool through share purchases. Viewers are told, “When you join this pool, you may purchase a share... ...which will provide the necessary equipment for building Bitcoin,” while the accompanying projection says the arrangement could produce around two to three times the Bitcoins over two and a half to three years. The invitation is practical as well as promotional: the title offers a call or WhatsApp contact, and the narration directs viewers to “refer back to the person that gave you this information” and closes with an invitation to the Mining Pool. Although Bitcoin price risk and “without promise or guarantee” wording are acknowledged, the proposed returns remain paired with a direct participation pathway.
